targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  COALESCE(inner_circle_cash, 0::double precision) AS cash
FROM bunker_social_state
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid
SELECT timestamp AS time, cash AS "Cash" FROM inner_circle_cash_samples WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

options.content: R frustration · G loyalty · B disposition

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision,
    COALESCE((SELECT popularity FROM inner_circle_members WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND slot_index = 0), 0::double precision)
  )) AS v
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Task progress
panels.description: Active assignment for this member (staging trip, groceries, temp job).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN task_ends_at IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
    ELSE LEAST(100::double precision,
      100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(NOW(), task_ends_at) - task_started_at))
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (task_ends_at - task_started_at)), 0))
    END AS progress
FROM inner_circle_members
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND slot_index = 0
